decisions.reason: The firm has publicly backed this modular plant concept, it fits the announced strategic direction toward modular environmental technology, and the reported customer savings make continued commitment easy to justify.

As a close extension of the established mobile processing range that remained prominently presented for two years, management would be inclined to persist because of prior investment, visible commitment and the absence of clear failure signals.
This modular concept has visible reference-customer adoption and quantified savings, so both strategic fit and positive market evidence support continuing it.

Because this slow-speed shredder line was only launched in 2024, management would likely treat any uncertainty as temporary and continue backing a product close to the core business after having already committed development and market-launch resources.

This new screening product supports the firm's broader modular and cleaner processing portfolio, and under escalation of commitment management would usually give such a recent, publicly launched product more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
